tables.name: QuestCommandHistory
tables.description: One row is one immutable, typed successful action input and its replay clocks, never a serialized command or account snapshot. Classification: Restricted. History: immutable. Erase with its account; no age cutoff on replay history.
tables.retention: Retain for the account lifetime, including recovery; erase with its account.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Stable transition UUID, equal to the operation UUID for a client command.

columns.name: AccountId
columns.description: Owning personal account; all references use this same ownership boundary.

columns.name: CommandReceiptId
columns.description: Receipt for a client command; null for an internal reconciliation or lifecycle transition. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: AccountMutationVersion
columns.description: Committed account sequence used to reconstruct a receipt or an issued sync anchor.

columns.name: ActionCode
columns.description: Stable command action or the documented internal reconciliation/lifecycle action.

columns.name: RulesetVersion
columns.description: Retained domain replay implementation version; never silently replay through a different ruleset.

columns.name: TimeZoneBefore
columns.description: IANA zone immediately before this transition; the first row preserves the initial account zone.

columns.name: ReconciledAt
columns.description: UTC clock through which due series deliveries were reconciled before applying the action.

columns.name: RecordedAt
columns.description: Verified UTC effective action time; may precede receipt by any duration.

columns.name: ProjectionAt
columns.description: Original UTC response projection time, independent of later retries.

columns.name: QuestOccurrenceId
columns.description: Target or server-resolved new occurrence identity. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: QuestCompletionId
columns.description: Completion selected by Undo. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: QuestDefinitionRevisionId
columns.description: Immutable quest terms supplied to a definition, acceptance, series or offer command. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: CompletionTermsRevisionId
columns.description: Frozen occurrence revision actually used for a delayed completion after a later edit. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: ExpectedRevision
columns.description: Optimistic public definition, skill or series revision supplied by the successful command. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: SystemSkillId
columns.description: System skill selected for assessment. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: CustomSkillId
columns.description: Owned skill selected for creation, editing, archival or assessment. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: SkillName
columns.description: Validated name supplied by a skill save command; this is historical input, not the mutable current name. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: ExperienceCode
columns.description: Validated experience selected for an assessment. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: DueOn
columns.description: Requested due or first-delivery local date. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: PlannedTime
columns.description: Requested local hour and minute. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: ParentQuestOccurrenceId
columns.description: Owned parent selected by a link command. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: ProfileRewardId
columns.description: Selected badge or frame; null also records an explicit clear. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: QuestSeriesId
columns.description: Owned recurrence selected for creation, edit or stop. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: CadenceCode
columns.description: Requested recurrence unit. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: Interval
columns.description: Requested positive recurrence interval. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: CategoryId
columns.description: Category pause/resume target; null means the whole account. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: ConfirmPenalty
columns.description: Whether the successful command explicitly confirmed penalty terms.

columns.name: AcceptedLoss
columns.description: Exact penalty amount accepted by the command. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: HasAcceptedTerms
columns.description: Whether the client supplied accepted quest terms; reconstruct them from the immutable typed terms reference.

columns.name: NewTimeZone
columns.description: Requested IANA zone for a zone-change command. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: ExpectedTimeZone
columns.description: Optimistic previous IANA zone supplied by the command. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: ConfirmZoneChange
columns.description: Whether a successful zone change was explicitly confirmed.

columns.name: HasExpiryWarnings
columns.description: Requested expiry-warning preference. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: SourceSyncAnchorId
columns.description: Original proof anchor, retaining offline acceptance provenance without copying an anchor snapshot. Null means not applicable to this transition.

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.description: UTC server insertion instant; never substituted for the effective action clock.

columns.name: ReconciliationLimit
columns.description: Maximum due-delivery cursor steps performed before this action; zero records lifecycle transitions that intentionally do not reconcile before freezing. Retain this input for exact partial-batch replay.

columns.name: ActionReconciliationLimit
columns.description: Maximum due-delivery cursor work performed by the action itself, such as a zone change or series creation; retained independently of the pre-action budget for exact original-response replay.
